rows.corpus_definition: A hole where liquid or gas escapes.
rows.example_en: There is a leak in the water pipe.

rows.corpus_definition: to move your body to rest against a surface
rows.example_en: Do not lean against the wet paint.

rows.corpus_definition: to not include something or someone in a group.
rows.example_en: Do not leave out any important details.

rows.corpus_definition: allowed or required by the rules of a country
rows.example_en: Smoking is not legal in this building.

rows.corpus_definition: free time when you are not working and can relax or have fun
rows.example_en: He spends his leisure time reading and gardening.

rows.corpus_definition: To give something to someone for a short time.
rows.example_en: I will lend my car to my brother.

rows.corpus_definition: To make someone feel sad by not doing what you promised.
rows.example_en: Please do not let me down this time.

rows.corpus_definition: A person who says things that are not true.
rows.example_en: Nobody believes him because he is a known liar.

rows.corpus_definition: An official paper that allows you to do or own something.
rows.example_en: You need a driving license to operate this car.

rows.corpus_definition: The greatest amount of something that is allowed.
rows.example_en: Please keep your phone calls to a short time.
